Chief Justice of India Surya Kant will inaugurate the platinum jubilee celebrations of the High Court of Kerala on Sunday (November 1). The ceremony will be held on the High Court premises at 11 a.m.
Supreme Court justice Sarasa Venkatanarayana Bhatti and Union Minister of State (Independent Charge) for the Ministry of Law and Justice Arjun Ram Meghwal will be the guests of honour. The inaugural function will be presided over by Chief Justice of the High Court of Kerala Soumen Sen.
The inaugural function will also be attended by the chief justices and judges of other High Courts, judges of the High Court of Kerala, former Judges of the Supreme Court of India and the High Courts, among others.
